text: 0216 left one comparison open: K4's period-71 reading of 0034, written backwards, read a little better than any copy's. If Sanborn reversed his message before enciphering it, that is where it would show.
The same pre-registered run of scrambled copies continued through 0034's own search until one copy read as well backwards; four backwards messages planted through the same search.

Fresh copy 14 reached -5.419 against K4's -5.458: not a flag, A13.3 ends with none. The plants were missed 4 of 4 times though each message itself would have been found: the forward climb overwrites a backwards message, so this test is weak for masks.
